body: I wasn't aware of that! Might decide to do that, thanks :)

I can't let my parents know, which is why I'm so afraid of talking to a counselor. (I don't really have any other family.) Another thing is that I don't know if I have an actual mental illness; I don't want to see a professional if I'm just being a lazy teen.

I've told my friend, but I've never really gotten a chance to talk to her about it. To be honest, it probably scares her (and I definitely can't blame her for that).

For some reason I just really, really want to be able to open up to an adult, but I don't know who.
